name: GlitchTip
description: Open-source error and performance monitoring platform compatible with the Sentry client SDKs.

envVars.description: Django secret key used to sign sessions and tokens
Password for the GlitchTip PostgreSQL database user
Email address used as the sender for notifications
Public URL GlitchTip is reachable at

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATABASE_URL: "postgres://glitchtip:{{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/glitchtip"
      REDIS_URL: "redis://{{serviceName}}-redis:6379/0"
      SECRET_KEY: {{env.SECRET_KEY}}
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL: {{env.DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL}}
      GLITCHTIP_DOMAIN: {{env.GLITCHTIP_DOMAIN}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/uploads:/code/uploads
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:15
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: glitchtip
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: glitchtip
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-worker:
    image: glitchtip/glitchtip:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-worker
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ./bin/run-celery-with-beat.sh
